ownership.publisher: Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Trade; Algiers Commercial Counsellor
ownership.note: This is independent government-directory association evidence for the frozen identity criterion. It is not legal registration proof, Algerian-government certification, a current-availability measurement or confirmation of every legacy entry in the directory.

conditions: Sequential Lighthouse 13.5.0 / Chrome 153 laboratory runs, up to three declared attempts per each of 3 predeclared pages on mobile and desktop; default simulated throttling and fresh browser processes. Per-pair successful-run counts and any unattempted runs are explicit; a collection stop is not a website failure. Operator network/geography unverified. Guarded DOM/axe observations use GET/HEAD and four-request concurrency; excluded requests can change rendering. No forms submitted, physical devices, field INP, full security audit, complete service process or 28-day reliability claim. Independent review pending. Different page samples are not a national comparison.
collectionNotes: 18 timing attempts recorded of 18 planned; 0 unattempted after collection limits.
3 distinct predeclared core page(s), with three attempts per page/device. Missing roles and narrower samples are not equivalent to complete website coverage.
contact: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.

Default Node chain construction failed; recovery supplied only independently root-verified public intermediates. Successful recovered trust does not certify complete server chain delivery or universal client compatibility.

The services page contains a personal-data handling notice referring to Law 18-07. Its existence is recorded; no legal/privacy compliance, consent behavior or secure submission certification is inferred.

Guarded contact rendering timed out, while the separate normal-browser follow-up rendered all three declared pages. Numerical widths alone were not used to award responsive or mobile usability points.

Completion review 2026-10-26 of the 21 October follow-up: 5 previously unmeasured criteria resolved, adding 6 assessed budget points. 3/3 additional core-page follow-ups were representative; excluded captures and original attempts are retained. Prior valid timing samples are unchanged. 36 criteria remain unmeasured; see the completion record for required evidence.

Supplementary GET search tasks, where present, use observed search forms and do not expand the original Lighthouse timing sample. Retained visual comparison is explicitly distinguished from fresh capture. Collector connection failures, robots exclusions and incomplete responses are never website zeros.

Coverage revision 2026-10-28: 4 further criteria resolved using explicit reviewed evidence. Restricted, untested and monitoring-dependent criteria remain unmeasured. Scores and measurement coverage are different quantities; no conversion of missing evidence to passes or zeros.

categories.label: External Security Posture and Technical Privacy

rows.label: HTTPS enforced
rows.reason: The declared HTTP entry upgraded to trusted HTTPS without an observed downgrade. Credit is limited to this captured entry chain.

rows.label: Valid TLS certificate
rows.reason: Hostname/date/chain-verified HTTPS succeeded with the separately root-verified public intermediates supplied to the recovery Node process. Default Node chain construction failed on some hosts; this is not evidence of complete server-delivered chains or universal client compatibility. See the recovery amendment.

rows.label: Modern TLS configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Full protocol/cipher assessment, not one negotiated connection. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: HSTS present and meaningful
rows.reason: Captured HSTS policies were parsed against the frozen rule: full requires max-age at least one year with includeSubDomains; a valid positive narrower policy earns half; absent, disabled or malformed earns zero. Worst declared page governs.

rows.label: Content-Security-Policy present and meaningful
rows.reason: The sampled document has no enforcing CSP header. Its meta policy is only upgrade-insecure-requests, which does not restrict script/object sources and earns zero under the frozen meaningful-policy rule.

rows.label: Other important security headers
rows.reason: Reviewed nosniff, DENY/SAMEORIGIN or restrictive frame-ancestors, and explicit meaningful Referrer-Policy values. Full needs all three protections, half some, zero none; worst sampled page governs.

rows.label: Secure cookie configuration
rows.reason: Only attributes of observed cookies are reviewed. Full requires Secure, HttpOnly and explicit Lax/Strict on all; partial means mixed protections. No names/values or complete consent/tracking audit are published.

rows.label: No mixed HTTP/HTTPS content
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Browser and sampled-page evidence. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: No unnecessary software/version exposure
rows.reason: The retained public response headers or generator metadata explicitly disclose WordPress 6.7.5. One verified disclosure prevents full or partial absence credit for the declared sample. This is an information-disclosure observation, not evidence that this version is vulnerable or unsupported.

rows.label: No obvious sensitive configuration exposure
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Passive eligible-page review only; no guessed sensitive paths. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Third-party tracking and technical privacy restraint
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Request inventory plus tracking classification. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Largest Contentful Paint
rows.reason: Worst page/device median lab LCP 31528 ms; full/half limits 2500/4000 ms. Not field p75.

rows.label: Responsiveness
rows.reason: Worst median lab TBT 144 ms; full/half limits 200/600 ms. Explicit lab proxy, not field INP.

rows.label: Cumulative Layout Shift
rows.reason: Worst median lab CLS 0.0018; full/half limits 0.1/0.25. Sampled navigation only.

rows.label: Server response and first content
rows.reason: Worst median FCP 18461 ms and document response audit 1720 ms. Full 1800/800; half 3000/1800. Response excludes connection/redirect time.

rows.label: Resource and page-weight efficiency
rows.reason: Worst median transfer 9148493 bytes, 187 requests. Full decimal 2MB/80; half 4MB/150.

rows.label: Performance consistency
rows.reason: Largest repeated within-page/device max/min LCP ratio 1.33; full/half 1.5/2. Operator network sample only.

rows.label: Verified WCAG 2.2 issue set

The newsletter label defect is also verified. These sampled defects prevent issue-set credit, without claiming a comprehensive WCAG audit.

rows.label: No significant broken internal links
rows.reason: Manually checked the declared bounded set of three retained core destinations: homepage and the two sampled service/contact/institution/news routes. The two inner destinations are actual cross-page anchors in another retained representative document, not inferred paths or self-fragment links; their destination captures returned HTTP 200 and rendered the expected page role. Full credit is limited to this explicit three-destination set. It is not an exhaustive crawl, a current-availability claim or a certification of downstream portals and form delivery.

rows.reason: Reviewed actual title/description values on the three representative documents: homepage identifies the ministry and official location, contact identifies its contact purpose/address, and services identifies electronic services with a substantive usage explanation. These are meaningful summaries of the sampled roles. Credit does not predict search visibility or cover all routes.

rows.label: Sitemap/crawlability configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: robots.txt and sitemap.xml observations. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Clean URLs, canonicalization and redirects
rows.reason: Manually compared all three retained 21 October representative page URLs with their actual canonical tags and the captured HTTP-entry redirect. Each page declares its corresponding same-site HTTPS canonical destination; the entry upgrades to HTTPS without a downgrade. Percent-encoding case differences do not change the destination. Full credit covers this declared sample, not arbitrary aliases, every parameter or verified search-engine indexing.

rows.label: Functional site search and discoverability
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Manual search task, not mere input presence. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: No critically outdated public technology

rows.label: Cross-page technical consistency

No template/encoding failure was established in that retained comparison. This limited consistency check does not certify all routes or browsers; separate metadata, ARIA, resource and layout findings retain their own scores.
